public_rationale: Marcus said GPT-5 did no better on the parts-and-wholes image problems that he and Ernest Davis wrote about in December. I found no independent test of these prompts on GPT-5 in August 2025. The closest evidence is Davis's own rerun from July 2025, a month before GPT-5. It found ChatGPT-4o's image generation much improved since November 2024: failures fell from 11 to 4, plus one new failure, though some problems remained. That points against 'no better'. But it predates GPT-5, and I could not confirm that GPT-5 used the same image engine. So the evidence does not settle the claim either way.
limitations: The only systematic test predates GPT-5.
Which image model GPT-5 ChatGPT used at launch is unconfirmed.
The reading of 'fared no better' (no improvement versus still failing) changes the result.
